RECORD OF INVESTIGATION.
Suspected Communistic Meeting
in Oriental Hotel.
At 9.00 p.m. on the 28-5-36, a telephone message was received at this Station from C.I. Shellswell, stating that a number of male Chinese were gathered together in Room No.411, Oriental Hotel, Nanking Road, and from literature observed in the room, it was suspected that a Communistic meeting was being held.
D.I. Duncan of the Special Branch was informed, and in company with Inspector Sih Tse Liang (薛志良) attended this Station and the above hotel to conduct enquiries, which ascertained that the persons in the room were as under:—
(1) Wong Ping Kwung (王炳坤), 34, Shanghai, M/editor, The Kwang Ming (光明) Book Shop, Soochow Road.
(2) Kying Shing (金鑫), 36, Canton, M/editor, 60 Route Dupleix, F.C.
(3) Zung Kong (陳康), 27, Canton, S/editor, 7 Tai Woo Fong (太和坊) Foochow Road.
(4) Zung Yoong (陳永), 26, Chekiang, M/editor, 104 Hoo Yuen Fong (花園坊), Route Pere Robert, F.C.
(5) Zien Tsing Zai (錢俊瑞), 29, Wusih, M/editor, The Sung Vo (生活) Book Shop, Foochow Road.
(6) Soo Zoong Yuen (蘇仲淵), 32, Soochow, M/editor, 23 Zau Kya Jau (曹家橋) Rd., West Gate, Nantao.
(7) Lee Tsoong Nyi (李宗基), 28, Yunnan, M/editor, 71 Love Lane.

涉嫌在东方饭店举行共产主义会议。
1936年5月28日晚9时，本捕房接到刑事侦缉探员谢尔思韦尔（Shellswell）的电话留言，称有多名中国男子聚集于南京路东方饭店411号房间，根据在该房间内观察到的文献资料，怀疑正在举行共产主义会议。
已通知特别支部督察邓肯（Duncan），其与督察薛志良一同来到本捕房及上述饭店进行调查，经查实，房间内人员如下：—
(1) 王炳坤，34岁，上海人，男，编辑，苏州路《光明》书局。
(2) 金鑫，36岁，广东人，男，编辑，法租界杜美路60号。
(3) 陳康，27岁，广东人，男，编辑，福州路太和坊7号。
(4) 陳永，26岁，浙江人，男，编辑，法租界罗伯特神父路花园坊104号。
(5) 錢俊瑞，29岁，无锡人，男，编辑，福州路《生活》书局。
(6) 蘇仲淵，32岁，苏州人，男，编辑，南市西门曹家桥路23号。
(7) 李宗基，28岁，云南人，男，编辑，爱文义路71号。

RECORD OF INVESTIGATION.
(8) Tsu Tsoong Ping (朱宗彬) 24, cashier,
s/student, Foo Tan University, Kiangwan.
Persons as above, all stated that they had
been called to the hotel by the 1st named, who engaged
the room, for the purpose of preparing a magazine for
publication, and extracts from literature found in the
room was to have been included.
Nothing was found to contradict the above.
Examination of the literature established that
this was not of a Communist nature, but dealing more
in a general criticism of prevailing conditions, and a
tendency towards that of Anti-Japanese nature.
In view of the above, no further action was
taken, but a warning was administered regarding the
use of licensed premises for the purpose of meetings
of a political nature.

(8) 朱宗彬，24岁，出纳员，
学生，江湾复旦大学。
上述人员均称，他们是由第一名所列人员召集至该饭店的，该人预订了房间，目的是筹备出版一本杂志，并计划收录在房间内发现的文献摘录。
未发现任何情况与上述说法相矛盾。
对文献的检查表明，其内容并非共产主义性质，而是更多地涉及对当时局势的一般性批评，并带有反日倾向。
鉴于上述情况，未采取进一步行动，但就利用持牌场所进行政治性质集会一事给予了警告。
